hooks.command: input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$path" ]; then dir=$(dirname "$path"); if git -C "$dir" check-ignore -q "$path" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Editing gitignored path is not allowed: $path" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi

input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$path" ]; then dir=$(dirname "$path"); if git -C "$dir" check-ignore -q "$path" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Writing to gitignored path is not allowed: $path" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
